jobs.description:
Description:
**POSITION TITLE:** Case Manager\-Employment Specialist

  



**PROGRAM/LOCATION:** San Luis Obispo ACT/ San Luis Obispo

 **POSITION SUMMARY:**


SLO ACT program is designed to engage adults with severe and persistent mental illness and provide treatment, rehabilitation, and social services in the community where they live, instead of a hospital or clinical setting. The SLO ACT team provides psychiatric treatment and rehabilitation services directly with a “whatever it takes” approach. For all SLO ACT clients, functioning in major life domains presents significant personal difficulties. These domains include affordable and safe housing; meaningful daily pursuits, including employment; and satisfying interpersonal relationships. Addressing the rehabilitation needs of clients in these key domains will be the team’s essential purpose. SLO ACT provides a full range of services, including assessment, individualized treatment planning, personal service coordination, integrated co\-occurring mental health and substance use disorder treatment, medication services, and access to support services on a 24/7, 365\-day basis. The Rehabilitation Specialist will have responsibility for supporting each client's recovery process, helping individuals to restore competencies and gain success in the major areas of community living using a trauma\-informed approach. These include permanent, affordable housing; successful daily life pursuits, particularly regular, competitive employment; and renewed relationships.

**HOURS/ SALARY EMPLOYEE PERKS:**


Full\-time, non\-exempt position. 40 hours per week. Anticipated hiring range is $25\.50\-$26\.50\. Includes a generous individual benefits package that includes health, dental, vision, life, 403b retirement (with up to a 5% employer match) paid vacation/holiday time, paid sick time and a variety of helpful employee perks as well. (\*Full Salary Schedule $25\.50\-$33\.00 per hour).

 **EMPLOYEE PERKS:**


A few of our helpful employee benefits include membership discounts to various local fitness centers. We offer years of service gift cards to businesses of your choice. We offer gift cards for walking, biking, or carpooling to work as well as 20% discount for shopping at our Growing Grounds Downtown Store/Nursey/ Farm. We host two employee appreciation events for employees and their families yearly. We practice Trauma Informed Care Principles, Guidelines for Collaborative Conversations, and encourage the use of pronouns. We mindfully promote equality, respect and diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, and all the fascinating characteristics that make us different! TMHA is also a pet friendly workplace (upon approval)!

**MISSION STATEMNET:**


Transitions Mental Health Association is a nonprofit organization dedicated to eliminating stigma and promoting recovery and wellness for people with mental illness through work, housing, community, and family support services.

**ORGANIZATION DESCRIPTION:**


Transitions – Mental Health Association is a leading non\-profit agency committed to providing comprehensive mental health services and support to individuals and families by inspiring hope, growth, recovery and wellness in our communities. TMHA has decades of experience with teams of compassionate staff. TMHA is a driving force in improving mental health and wellness in our communities and a supportive and inclusive work environment that values diversity and individual contributions.

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:**


1\. Provide case management for an assigned group of clients including coordinating and monitoring the activities of the individual treatment team; assume primary responsibility for developing, writing, implementing, evaluating and revising treatment goals and plans; adhering to all required reporting requirements; provide one\-on\-one support to clients; provide symptom management support; educate and support clients’ families while acting in the clients’ best interest and advocating for the rights of the clients. Assist clients in all aspects of independent living including the development of social, vocational, and effective life management skills; assist clients in the areas of proper nutrition, cooking, shopping, budgeting, housecleaning, and maintenance, and personal hygiene.


2\. Participate in the completion of client\-centered comprehensive assessment of psychiatric history (e.g., onset, course and effect of illness, past treatment and responses, and risk behaviors), mental status, and diagnosis; physical health and dental health; use of drugs or alcohol; education and employment; social development and functioning; activities of


daily living (e.g., self\-care, living situation, nutrition, money management) and family structure and relationships.


3\. Supports and assists clients of mental health services in a social rehabilitation setting offering social support, skills training, recreational activities, employment development, and assistance with independent living skills.


4\. Function as a full member of the multidisciplinary ACT team within a shared caseload model.


5\. Incorporate relapse prevention and wellness planning into employment supports.


6\. Promote self\-confidence and workplace readiness through skill\-building interventions.


7\. Conduct employer outreach and job development activities in the community.


8\. Develop relationships with local businesses to create competitive employment opportunities.


9\. Address barriers to employment, including stigma, symptom management, substance use recovery, and legal issues.


10\. Functions as a role model to clients regarding rehabilitation and recovery, communication skills, and work behavior.


11\. Support clients in identifying personal strengths, career interests, and long\-term vocational goals.


12\. Provide job coaching and on\-site support as needed.

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a compassionate, organized, and detail\-oriented **Patient Care Coordinator** to join our growing home health team. In this office\-based role, you will coordinate patient care services, communicate with physicians and healthcare providers, schedule home health visits, and ensure patients receive quality care promptly. The ideal candidate has excellent communication skills, can multitask in a fast\-paced environment, and is committed to providing outstanding customer service to patients and their families.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and schedule home health visits for clinicians.
* Communicate with patients, families, physicians, and referral sources.
* Verify insurance information and obtain authorizations as needed.
* Maintain accurate patient records in the electronic medical record (EMR) system.
* Answer incoming calls and assist with patient inquiries.
* Ensure all documentation is complete and compliant with agency policies and regulations.
* Work closely with the clinical team to support continuity of patient care.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; healthcare or medical office experience preferred.
* Previous experience in home health, healthcare coordination, or medical office setting is a plus.
* Strong organizational, communication, and customer service skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and EMR systems.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and work efficiently in a team environment.
* Spanish\-speaking candidates are preferred, but not required

If you are passionate about helping others and enjoy working in a collaborative healthcare environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of our dedicated home health team.

Pay: $19\.00 \- $23\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

**Title:** Memory Care Coordinator

Job Summary
  
The Memory Care Coordinator is responsible for coordinating the daily operations of the
  
Memory Care neighborhood while promoting a safe, engaging, and person\-centered environment
  
for residents living with Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia.
  
This position serves as a hybrid role by combining responsibilities within the Memory Care
  
Department and the Activities Department. The Memory Care Coordinator oversees resident
  
engagement programming, supports quality resident care, partners with nursing and caregiving
  
staff, communicates with families, and assists the Executive Director in ensuring the Memory
  
Care program operates efficiently and in compliance with all applicable regulations and Glen
  
Park Senior Living standards.
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  
Resident Care \& Quality
  
1\. Assist in coordinating the daily operations of the Memory Care neighborhood.
  
2\. Promote person\-centered dementia care practices.
  
3\. Monitor residents' overall well\-being and communicate changes to the nursing team.
  
4\. Participate in resident assessments, care conferences, and care plan meetings as assigned.
  
5\. Ensure residents receive compassionate, respectful, and individualized care.
  
6\. Observe resident behaviors and collaborate with the interdisciplinary team to develop
  
appropriate interventions.
  
7\. Promote resident dignity, independence, and quality of life.
  
8\. Assist residents who require assistance with the activities of daily living, e.g., bathing,
  
dressing, grooming, eating, toileting, etc.\- as needed.
  
9\. Dispense medications, and maintain medication administration records\- as needed.

2\. Plan meaningful therapeutic programming appropriate for residents with cognitive
  
impairment.

o Social interaction
  
o Cognitive stimulation
  
o Physical wellness
  
o Emotional well\-being
  
o Sensory engagement
  
o Spiritual enrichment
  
4\. Coordinate outings, entertainment, family events, and holiday celebrations.
  
5\. Evaluate resident participation and modify programming based on resident needs.
  
Family Relations
  
1\. Serve as a primary point of contact for Memory Care families.
  
2\. Build positive relationships with residents and family members.
  
3\. Provide updates regarding resident participation and overall well\-being.
  
4\. Assist families during admissions and transitions into Memory Care.
  
5\. Participate in family meetings as requested.
  
Staff Leadership
  
1\. Provide day\-to\-day guidance and support to caregivers assigned to Memory Care.
  
2\. Assist with onboarding and training new Memory Care staff.
  
3\. Reinforce Glen Park's dementia care philosophy and customer service standards.
  
4\. Identify opportunities for coaching and staff development.
  
5\. Work collaboratively with Nursing, Activities, Dining Services, Housekeeping, and
  
Maintenance.
  
Compliance \& Documentation
  
1\. Assist in maintaining compliance with all California Department of Social Services
  
regulations.
  
2\. Maintain activity participation records and required documentation.
  
3\. Ensure Memory Care activity supplies and equipment are maintained.
  
4\. Assist with survey readiness and quality assurance initiatives.
  
5\. Report safety concerns, incidents, or changes in resident condition immediately.
  
Administrative Responsibilities
  
1\. Assist with scheduling Memory Care activities and special events.
  
2\. Monitor activity supply inventory and submit purchasing requests.
  
3\. Support occupancy efforts by participating in tours when requested.
  
4\. Assist the Executive Director with special projects related to Memory Care operations.
  
5\. Attend leadership meetings and interdisciplinary team meetings as assigned.
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Associate or Bachelor degree in Recreation Therapy, Gerontology, Healthcare


Administration, Nursing, Social Services, or related field preferred.
  
* Minimum two (2\) years of experience working with seniors, preferably in Memory Care.
* Previous supervisory or leadership experience preferred.
* Experience working with residents living with Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.
* Current CPR and First Aid certification or ability to obtain upon hire.
* Ability to successfully pass all required background clearances and physical examination.


Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities
  
* Strong leadership and organizational skills.

* Ability to de\-escalate challenging behaviors.
* Ability to build strong relationships with residents and families.
* Ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment.

Physical Requirements
  
* Frequently stand, walk, bend, reach, and assist residents throughout the day.

jobs.title: RISE Academy 2026-2027 After School Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
About RISE Academy



RISE Academy is a subsidiary of RISE Education System, a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit educational organization accredited by the Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC) and Cognia. Our mission is to promote the holistic development of the child through an authentic and experiential student learning experience. This is accomplished by educating the child in the formation of faith, family, and community.



RISE Academy strives to develop the whole child by providing excellence in academic preparation within a faith\-based environment. Our vision is to guide and nurture students to become role models who exhibit high levels of God\-consciousness, professional excellence, and civic leadership through service to society at large.

  

Position Overview



RISE Academy is seeking a part\-time, in\-person After\-School Program Coordinator to support and lead our after\-school program at our campus in San Jose, California.



The After\-School Program Coordinator will report to the Head of Development and will provide leadership, supervision, and support for a holistic, multi\-age after\-school program serving students Monday through Thursday from 2:45 PM to 5:15 PM.



The Coordinator will help create a safe, structured, engaging, and nurturing environment that educates, enriches, and inspires students beyond the regular school day.

  

Job Expectations



Shared Vision



Supports RISE Academy’s vision of excellence for all students and approaches the work with a sense of care, responsibility, and urgency to help students thrive.



Culture of Excellence



Helps foster a safe, respectful, culturally responsive, and nurturing environment where students feel welcomed, supported, and excited to participate.



Professional Growth



Demonstrates a commitment to continuous growth, participates in required trainings, and contributes positively to the school’s professional community.



Community Engagement



Communicates regularly and professionally with families, staff, and school leaders, and supports key school community events when needed.

  

Responsibilities



The After\-School Program Coordinator’s responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


* Plan and implement the daily after\-school program in alignment with the school’s mission, values, and expectations.
* Create a structured, engaging, and developmentally appropriate environment for students across multiple age groups.
* Lead academic, cultural, recreational, and enrichment activities, including preparing necessary supplies and materials.
* Supervise students in classrooms, activity areas, outdoor spaces, and other designated program locations.
* Use age\-appropriate methods rooted in positive youth development principles.
* Maintain a safe environment and respond appropriately to student needs, conflicts, injuries, or emergencies.
* Communicate with school staff, parents, and administrators regarding program activities, student needs, behavior, academic support, and events.
* Maintain a professional attitude, appearance, and rapport with students, families, staff, and community members.
* Support the promotion of the after\-school program, including assisting with basic marketing materials and family communication.
* Attend required staff meetings, trainings, and professional development sessions.
* Support off\-site after\-school field trips, when applicable.
* Assist with administrative tasks related to the after\-school program and other duties as assigned, with the possibility of additional hours depending on program needs.

  

  

Required Skills and Qualifications


* Experience working with students in a recreational, educational, school, or community youth setting.
* Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with students, staff, parents, and community members.
* Strong communication, organization, and supervision skills.
* Familiarity with quality practices for after\-school or youth development programs.
* Ability to demonstrate patience, professionalism, sound judgment, and sensitivity to the needs of students and families.
* Ability to respond calmly and swiftly in critical incidents or emergency situations.
* CPR and First Aid certification, or willingness to obtain certification.
* Physical ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, and actively supervise students for extended periods of time.
* Physical ability to lead, supervise, and participate in structured indoor and outdoor student activities.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds, including program supplies, activity materials, and other items as needed.

  

  

Preferred Qualifications


* Two or more years of experience working with children in an educational or youth development environment.
* Experience planning or coordinating student activities, enrichment programming, or after\-school programming.
* Experience working with students across multiple grade levels.

  

  

Compensation



Compensation is based on experience, education, certifications, and the scope of assigned responsibilities. Children of eligible staff members may qualify for tuition discounts in accordance with RISE Academy’s staff discount policy.

jobs.title: Client Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Client Care Coordinator**

**Remote \| Part\-Time**

Integrated Therapy and Recovery, Inc. is seeking an organized, responsive, and client\-centered **Client Care Coordinator** to manage incoming referrals and guide clients through scheduling and intake. The role focuses heavily on Veterans referred through the VA Community Care Network, with support for other referral sources as needed.

**Responsibilities**

* Receive, review, and track incoming referrals and authorizations.
* Contact prospective clients promptly and explain the intake process.
* Coordinate scheduling and match clients with an appropriate therapist.
* Send portal invitations, intake paperwork, appointment information, and reminders.
* Follow up with clients who have not responded or completed required steps.
* Track authorization details, visit limits, expiration dates, and pending requests.
* Identify missing referral information and follow up with referral sources.
* Coordinate communication among clients, therapists, referral sources, and the administrative team.
* Assist with records requests and other referral\-related documentation.
* Maintain accurate, HIPAA\-compliant records of outreach, referral status, and pending actions.
* Escalate clinical, eligibility, authorization, or safety concerns to the appropriate team member.
* Provide regular updates on pending referrals, scheduling barriers, and completed intakes.

**Qualifications**

* At least two years of experience in healthcare administration, client coordination, medical scheduling, referral management, behavioral health administration, or a related role.
* Strong organization, follow\-through, and attention to detail.
* Warm, professional phone and written communication.
* Comfortable contacting clients via call, email and text \- and following up consistently.
* Ability to manage multiple referrals and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently and reliably in a remote environment.
* Experience handling confidential information.
* Proficiency with email, spreadsheets, electronic records, and virtual communication platforms.

**Preferred Experience**

* Behavioral health or therapy practice administration.
* VA Community Care, TriWest, Optum, military healthcare, or Veteran services.
* Referrals, authorizations, or medical records requests.
* SimplePractice or another electronic health record system.
* Telehealth coordination.

**Remote Work and Technology Requirements**

* Reliable high\-speed internet capable of consistently supporting video meetings, cloud\-based applications, and internet\-based phone services
* Access to a dependable computer with a functioning camera, microphone, and speakers
* The ability to use Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, web\-based healthcare systems, and other online platforms simultaneously
* A private, quiet workspace where confidential conversations and protected client information cannot be seen or overheard
* A secure, password\-protected internet connection; public or unsecured Wi\-Fi may not be used for work involving confidential information
* Basic technical proficiency, including the ability to install approved applications, manage system updates, troubleshoot routine connectivity issues, and participate in video meetings with the camera on when required

Candidates may be asked to complete an internet speed test and participate in a video\-based technology check as part of the hiring process.

**About ITR**

Integrated Therapy and Recovery, Inc. is a California nonprofit behavioral health practice providing telehealth therapy to Veterans, individuals, couples, and families. Our clinicians specialize in trauma, sex addiction, betrayal recovery, and couples counseling.

Pay: From $20\.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
